release.title: Nonclinical Safety Semantic Runtime
release.description: Portable semantic, resolver, authorization, projection, and presentation contract for cross-domain nonclinical safety investigation.

objects.label: Compound
objects.description: Investigational material anchor with identifiers and normalized chemical structure references.

objects.label: Study
objects.description: Immutable nonclinical study snapshot and protocol context.

objects.label: Treatment group
objects.description: Cohort dose assignment and exposure context.

objects.label: Animal subject
objects.description: Governed study subject identity and group assignment.

objects.label: Microscopic finding
objects.description: Tissue finding with organ, morphology, severity, subject, and lineage.

objects.label: Laboratory measurement
objects.description: Longitudinal analyte result with unit, time, group, and subject context.

objects.label: Organ measurement
objects.description: Absolute or normalized organ measurement with specimen, method, unit, subject, phase, and source lineage.

objects.label: Body-weight measurement
objects.description: Longitudinal body weight or body-weight gain measurement for one subject and study time.

objects.label: Clinical observation
objects.description: In-life observation with finding, severity or status, body location, subject, and study time.

objects.label: Macroscopic finding
objects.description: Gross pathology observation with specimen, morphology, subject, phase, and lineage.

objects.label: Exposure administration
objects.description: Administered treatment amount, route, formulation context, subject or pool, and study time.

objects.label: Toxicokinetic concentration
objects.description: Measured analyte concentration with specimen, time, subject or pool, unit, and quantification context.

objects.label: Toxicokinetic parameter
objects.description: Derived exposure parameter such as AUC or Cmax with group, sex, period, and unit context.

objects.label: Study phase
objects.description: Trial element, subject element, disposition, terminal sacrifice, or recovery-period context.

objects.label: Food consumption
objects.description: Longitudinal food-consumption measurement for a subject or group.

objects.label: Evidence relationship
objects.description: Typed source-declared or governed inferred relationship between canonical evidence records.

objects.label: Endpoint summary
objects.description: Rebuildable study, endpoint, sex, group, and phase aggregation with exact source-record membership.

objects.label: Target-organ assessment
objects.description: Versioned expert-controlled assessment that binds pathology, measurements, exposure, recovery, and rationale without mutating source evidence.

objects.label: Source artifact
objects.description: Checksum-verified artifact from which evidence was derived.

objects.label: Scientific publication
objects.description: External contextual evidence with bibliographic identity, content-rights status, retrieval provenance, and explicit relevance to a study concept.

objects.label: Evidence passage
objects.description: Licensed, section-aware text fragment with a source locator, semantic bindings, embedding, and parent-publication provenance.

objects.label: Evidence assertion
objects.description: Snapshot-bound and cited hypothesis assembled from governed evidence.

objects.label: Review decision
objects.description: Solution-owned expert decision that does not mutate source evidence.

profiles.label: Data steward
profiles.description: Inspects lineage, terminology, mappings, and discrepancies.

profiles.label: Portfolio lead
profiles.description: Reads aggregate and cross-study similarity evidence.

profiles.label: External reviewer
profiles.description: Reads published evidence, lineage, and submitted briefs.

capabilities.label: Rank findings for review
capabilities.description: Structured incidence and severity analysis for one snapshot.

capabilities.label: Expand evidence neighborhood
capabilities.description: Graph traversal from finding to subjects, groups, labs, and lineage.

capabilities.label: Resolve biological coherence
capabilities.description: Assemble pathology, organ and body weight, laboratory, clinical observation, exposure, and phase evidence for one target-organ hypothesis.

capabilities.label: Assess reversibility evidence
capabilities.description: Compare terminal and recovery cohorts for the same endpoint with exact source-record membership.

capabilities.label: Review target-organ assessment
capabilities.description: Record an expert adversity and reversibility assessment over cited immutable evidence.

capabilities.label: Retrieve similar findings
capabilities.description: Cross-study retrieval over semantic concepts, normalized dose incidence, severity profiles, and optional embeddings, followed by reciprocal-rank fusion and domain reranking.

capabilities.label: Retrieve literature evidence
capabilities.description: Ground study concepts to PubMed or licensed full text, perform hybrid retrieval, and rerank by species, organ, morphology, and study design.

capabilities.label: Assemble evidence brief
capabilities.description: Cited synthesis over authorized evidence and review state.

capabilities.label: Inspect semantic model
capabilities.description: Explains business objects, concepts, resolvers, collections, and indexes.

surfaces.label: Business documents
surfaces.description: Domain objects and cohesive document fragments.

surfaces.label: Search, graph & vectors
surfaces.description: Resolver contracts and hybrid retrieval indexes.

surfaces.label: Physical placements
surfaces.description: MongoDB collections, API resources, object storage, paths, authority, and protected write boundaries.

archetypes.label: Study evidence aggregate
archetypes.description: Snapshot-bound study root composed from protocol, treatment, finding, laboratory, and lineage roles.

archetypes.label: Contextual literature evidence
archetypes.description: Bibliographic identity plus permitted passages, semantic bindings, rights, and source locators.

archetypes.label: Governed evidence brief
archetypes.description: Cited agent hypothesis and append-only expert disposition over immutable evidence.

archetypes.label: Target-organ biological coherence
archetypes.description: Snapshot-bound target-organ evidence across pathology, organ and body weight, laboratory, clinical observation, exposure, study phase, and source-declared relationships.

archetypes.label: Governed target-organ assessment
archetypes.description: Expert-controlled adversity and reversibility decision with cited endpoint summaries and immutable review history.

sourceAdapters.role: Bibliographic metadata, abstracts, MeSH terms, and identifiers

rules: Every answer is bound to one study snapshot and profile.
Every synthesized assertion exposes source citations.
Authorization is enforced by the API.
